chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Hilal from al-Fadl ibn Dakin from Ma'mar ibn Rashid. He said: I heard Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) saying:
A Jew came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and stood before him, staring intently at him. So he said: 'O Jew! What is your need?'
He said: 'Are you more virtuous, or Moses the son of Imran, the prophet whom God spoke to, who was given the Torah and the staff, for whom the sea was split, and who was shaded by the cloud?'

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'It is disliked for a servant to praise himself, but I will say: When Adam (peace be upon him) committed the mistake, his repentance was that he said: O God! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to forgive me. So God forgave it for him.
When Noah (peace be upon him) boarded the Ark and feared drowning, he said: O God! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to save me from drowning. So God saved him from it.

When Ibrahim (peace be upon him) was thrown into the fire, he said: O God! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to deliver me from it. So God made it cool and peaceful for him.

When Moses (peace be upon him) cast his staff and felt fear in himself, he said: O God! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to keep me safe from this. Then God, Majestic is His majesty, said:
Fear not! Surely, it is you who is superior. [Quran 20:68]

O Jew! If Moses were to meet me and then disbelieve in me and my prophethood, his faith would not avail him at all, nor would his prophethood avail him. O Jew! From my progeny is the Mahdi. When he appears, Jesus the son of Mary will descend to support him, and he will lead him forward and pray behind him.'

key_terms.التوسل بحق محمد وآل محمد: Seeking intercession through the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad — a key Shia theological concept of tawassul
key_terms.الخطيئة: The mistake/sin — refers to Adam's act of disobedience in the garden
key_terms.المهدي: The Mahdi — the awaited savior from the progeny of the Prophet
key_terms.النبوة: Prophethood — the divine office of conveying God's message
key_terms.بردا وسلاما: Cool and peaceful — the Quranic description of the fire's treatment of Ibrahim (21:69)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the prophets seeking intercession through Muhammad and his family?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) relates that a Jewish man questioned the Prophet (SAWW) about his superiority over Moses (AS). The Prophet responded by narrating how the great prophets — Adam, Noah, Ibrahim, and Moses — each sought intercession through Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad in their moments of crisis, demonstrating that the spiritual rank of Muhammad (SAWW) and his progeny transcends all eras. The Prophet concluded by declaring the necessity of believing in him and announcing that the Mahdi from his progeny will appear, with Jesus (AS) praying behind him as a follower.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim narrated to me from Ahmad b. Hilal from al-Fadl b. Dakin from Mu`ammar b. Rashid.  He said: I heard Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) say:
A Jew came to the Prophet (sw) and stood in front of him, staring at him. So, he said: “O Jew! What do you need?”
He said: “Are you more virtuous or Musa the son of Imran, the prophet whom Allah spoke to, who was given the Torah and the staff, for whom the sea was split, and who was shaded by the cloud?”

So, the Prophet (sw) said to him: “It is disliked for a servant to praise himself, but I will say:
When Adam (as) made the mistake, he repented by saying: ‘O Allah! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to forgive me.’ So, Allah pardoned it for him.
When Nuh (as) boarded the Ark and feared drowning, he said: ‘O Allah! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to save me from drowning.’ So, Allah saved him from that.
When Ibrahim (as) was thrown into the fire, he said: ‘O Allah! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to deliver me from this.’ So, Allah made it cool and peaceful.
When Musa (as) cast his staff and felt fear in himself, he said: ‘O Allah! I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad to keep me safe from this.’ So, Allah said: ‘
Fear not. Surely, it is you who is superior.’ [20:68]

O Jew! [Even] if Moses were to meet me and disbelieve in me and my prophethood, his faith would not avail him at all, nor would his prophethood avail him.
O Jew! From my progeny is the Mahdi. When he appears, Jesus the son of Mary will descend to support him, and he will pray behind him.”
